title: Optimize png files by reducing amount of colors to 255 + use oxipng max compression
body:
**While formally it is lossy change it doesn't effect visuals!**

Godot head have only 4 colors (counting transparent) but in non quantized form our files use dozens of colors. Usually 500 and up to 1000 in one of them. All additional colors are colors used to anti-alias the image. Lots of them are used in file only once or twice. They are mostly indistinguishable between each other so they are safe to remove. When we reduce count of colors used by PNG file to 256, we can change it is mode to "Indexed". In this mode palette is created (up to 256 colors) and all the pixels are described not by using RGB(A) 3/4 bytes but by in index in palette 1 byte

I've **manually checked** _all the files_ with [Identity](https://flathub.org/apps/org.gnome.gitlab.YaLTeR.Identity) in side-by-side view. The only "regression" I've spot is that for low-res `platform/android/**/icon_foreground.png` the blue color near white jaw connection is more contrast than in original. It is hard to spot even with max zoom so I doesn't consider it as something bad especially because they are intended not to be zoomed at all
![screen-1733084649](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f876275-bcca-43e3-96e4-f5a681bcdb0b)

The file from `tests` folder in general a copy of main `icon.png` but just with more artifacts so I replaced it with of `icon.png`. Artifacts are harder to compress so this particular change saved 5kb
